# Fork-PR preview allowlist — read by .github/workflows/fork-preview.yml.
#
# GitHub usernames, one per line, case-insensitive; # starts a comment. Org
# members, repo collaborators, and anyone with at least one PR already merged
# into this repo are trusted automatically and never need a line — so this
# list is only for trusting an author BEFORE their first merge (a line here
# becomes redundant, though harmless, once their PR lands).
#
# Adding a name is a ONE-TIME approval: every future PR that user opens from
# their fork gets its live preview published automatically. What you are
# approving: their PR's built HTML is served from
# https://iliad-team.github.io/iliad-intensive/pr-preview/pr-<N>/ — the same
# origin as the production site — with no further human in the loop. Only the
# copy of this file on main counts; a PR editing it cannot allowlist itself.
